{{Quote|What's that?''"<br />"''It's a droid dispenser, 07. Next time, read the briefing.|Republic commandos Sev and Fixer|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>|audio=Fixer-ReadBriefing.flac}}
A '''droid dispenser''' was a roughly cylindrical container, that could transport, dispense and possibly construct [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and later more predominantly by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to continually dispense a supply of battle droids.

Droid dispensers saw action during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the capture of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], ''[[Prosecutor]]'' and during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], sending in [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] or [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]] and occasionally [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] against the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Some were also employed to dispatch reinforcements by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] allied with the Confederacy.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the video game ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', the droid dispensers will continue deploying droids until the dispenser itself is destroyed, it is not clear whether this is simply game mechanics or if the dispensers did indeed somehow have an unlimited supply of droids.
